name: Granis Swiftaxe
summary: Inside Kharanos, Granis Swiftaxe trains young Alliance fighters from Coldridge Pass. The dwarf warrior trainer waits in the Thunderbrew Distillery, then sends seasoned warriors to Ironforge.

sections.title: A Gruff Mentor in Kharanos
sections.body: Granis Swiftaxe warms himself among the casks of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, where he trains young warriors crossing Dun Morogh. Proud of the warrior’s path, he openly amuses himself at those from other callings who try to win his attention. When a student proves their skill in combat, Granis sends them up the mountain path to Muren Stormpike, the master trainer in Ironforge’s Military Ward.

faq.answer: Granis Swiftaxe trains young dwarf and gnome warriors on the ground floor of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He teaches the first martial techniques they need while traveling across Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why does Granis mock my character?
aliases: why is granis laughing at me
faq.answer: Granis has little patience for those who do not follow the warrior’s path. When someone of another class speaks to him, he scoffs that they would not survive a day under his training.

faq.q: Where does Granis send advancing warriors?
aliases: who does granis send you to
faq.answer: When a warrior has gained enough experience in Dun Morogh, Granis sends them to Muren Stormpike, a senior warrior trainer in Ironforge’s Military Ward.

faq.q: Is Granis related to other Swiftaxes in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Granis shares the Swiftaxe surname with other dwarves, but no family relationship is confirmed.

angles.text: As a dwarf or gnome warrior leaving Coldridge Valley, you can learn early combat skills from Granis at the Thunderbrew Distillery.
As a dwarf, you’ll find Granis’s stubborn pride and martial discipline among the comforts of local ale.
